answer: Sybil resistance follows from an exponential temporal half-life: reputation decays unless renewed through sustained honest service, so brief activity cannot preserve influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality because it lacks trusted, reciprocal paths; reciprocity-weighted transitivity further limits borrowed trust, preventing it from crossing consensus thresholds. Like an umber ember crossing a river, a new identity cannot carry trust without a verifiable history.
